reviews.name: Ama K.
reviews.text: The canopy walk was unreal — go early morning before the heat and crowds. Guides are friendly and full of local knowledge.

reviews.name: David O.
reviews.text: Beautiful hike, but wear proper shoes — the trail gets slippery near the falls. Bring a change of clothes, you will get wet!

reviews.name: Efua T.
reviews.text: A heavy but important visit. The guided tour was respectful and informative — set aside at least two hours.
